entries.text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
entries.source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

entries.text: You see Sophia, an instructor for the Brotherhood Initiates.
entries.source_text: You see Sophia, an instructor for the Brotherhood Initiates.

entries.text: 你看到索菲娅，一个兄弟会新兵的指导员。
entries.source_text: 你看到索菲娅，一个兄弟会新兵的指导员。

entries.text: Ok, does anyone have any questions?
entries.source_text: Ok, does anyone have any questions?

entries.text: 好了，有人有问题吗？
entries.source_text: 好了，有人有问题吗？

entries.text: Remember to ask questions if you don't understand something. Don't be shy.
entries.source_text: Remember to ask questions if you don't understand something. Don't be shy.

entries.text: 记得当你不懂的时候一定要提问题，不要害羞。
entries.source_text: 记得当你不懂的时候一定要提问题，不要害羞。

entries.text: Review your notes.
entries.source_text: Review your notes.

entries.text: 复习你们的笔记。
entries.source_text: 复习你们的笔记。

entries.text: We'll be having another test tomorrow for those of you that are on section 14.
entries.source_text: We'll be having another test tomorrow for those of you that are on section 14.

entries.text: 学到第14部分的同学，我们明天要进行一次测试。
entries.source_text: 学到第14部分的同学，我们明天要进行一次测试。

entries.text: I'm sorry, but I can't talk right now. I have a class to run.
entries.source_text: I'm sorry, but I can't talk right now. I have a class to run.

entries.text: 对不起，我现在不能说话，还要上课呢。
entries.source_text: 对不起，我现在不能说话，还要上课呢。

entries.text: I understand you have something for me.
entries.source_text: I understand you have something for me.

entries.text: 我认为你有什么东西要给我。
entries.source_text: 我认为你有什么东西要给我。

entries.text: Yes. Here you are.
entries.source_text: Yes. Here you are.

entries.text: 是的。给你。
entries.source_text: 是的。给你。

entries.text: Yes, but I don't have it with me right now.
entries.source_text: Yes, but I don't have it with me right now.

entries.text: 没错，但是我现在没有带在身上。
entries.source_text: 没错，但是我现在没有带在身上。

entries.text: You.
entries.source_text: You.

entries.text: 你。
entries.source_text: 你。

entries.text: I'm sorry, but I have a class to run. Please don't disturb me.
entries.source_text: I'm sorry, but I have a class to run. Please don't disturb me.

entries.text: 对不起，我还要上课，请不要打扰。
entries.source_text: 对不起，我还要上课，请不要打扰。

entries.text: You shouldn't be here. Vree doesn't like to be bothered at night. This is the time we meditate.
entries.source_text: You shouldn't be here. Vree doesn't like to be bothered at night. This is the time we meditate.

entries.text: 你不该来这里。弗蕾不喜欢晚上有人来打扰，这是我们冥想的时间。
entries.source_text: 你不该来这里。弗蕾不喜欢晚上有人来打扰，这是我们冥想的时间。

entries.text: We are meditating. Please leave. Come back in the morning.
entries.source_text: We are meditating. Please leave. Come back in the morning.

entries.text: 我们在冥想。请离开，早上再来。
entries.source_text: 我们在冥想。请离开，早上再来。

entries.text: Leave us.
entries.source_text: Leave us.

entries.text: 离开这里。
entries.source_text: 离开这里。

entries.text: Have some respect. Don't bother someone while they're meditating.
entries.source_text: Have some respect. Don't bother someone while they're meditating.

entries.text: 请放尊重些，别人冥想时不要打扰。
entries.source_text: 请放尊重些，别人冥想时不要打扰。

entries.text: You Initiates have a lot to learn. Please leave.
entries.source_text: You Initiates have a lot to learn. Please leave.

entries.text: 你们新兵有很多需要学习的东西，赶快离开吧。
entries.source_text: 你们新兵有很多需要学习的东西，赶快离开吧。

entries.text: Don't bother me.
entries.source_text: Don't bother me.

entries.text: 不要打扰我。
entries.source_text: 不要打扰我。

entries.text: We are not available during the night. Please see us in the morning.
entries.source_text: We are not available during the night. Please see us in the morning.

entries.text: 我们在晚上不能做任何事。请在白天来见我们。
entries.source_text: 我们在晚上不能做任何事。请在白天来见我们。

entries.text: It's night. You should be in bed, unless you have guard duty, in which case you should be at your post.
entries.source_text: It's night. You should be in bed, unless you have guard duty, in which case you should be at your post.

entries.text: 现在是晚上。你应该在床上睡觉，除非你有守卫任务，但即使是那样你也应该在岗位上。
entries.source_text: 现在是晚上。你应该在床上睡觉，除非你有守卫任务，但即使是那样你也应该在岗位上。

entries.text: Hello Initiate. How may I help you?
entries.source_text: Hello Initiate. How may I help you?

entries.text: 你好，新兵。我能帮你吗？
entries.source_text: 你好，新兵。我能帮你吗？

entries.text: I understand you have something for me?
entries.source_text: I understand you have something for me?

entries.text: 我认为你有什么东西要给我。
entries.source_text: 我认为你有什么东西要给我。

entries.text: Yes, here you are.
entries.source_text: Yes, here you are.

entries.text: 是的。给你。
entries.source_text: 是的。给你。

entries.text: Yes, but I don't have it with me right now.
entries.source_text: Yes, but I don't have it with me right now.

entries.text: 没错，但是我现在没有带在身上。
entries.source_text: 没错，但是我现在没有带在身上。

entries.text: Me? Nope, sorry. You must have me mistaken for someone else.
entries.source_text: Me? Nope, sorry. You must have me mistaken for someone else.

entries.text: 我？对不起，我想你认错人了。
entries.source_text: 我？对不起，我想你认错人了。

entries.text: Uk.
entries.source_text: Uk.

entries.text: 呃咳。
entries.source_text: 呃咳。

entries.text: Thank you very much. It was nice of you to drop these off.
entries.source_text: Thank you very much. It was nice of you to drop these off.

entries.text: 非常感谢你带来这些东西。
entries.source_text: 非常感谢你带来这些东西。

entries.text: Um, thank you. Are you okay? Well anyway, it was nice of you to drop these off.
entries.source_text: Um, thank you. Are you okay? Well anyway, it was nice of you to drop these off.

entries.text: 呃，谢谢你。你还好吗？不管怎么说还是谢谢你带来这些东西。
entries.source_text: 呃，谢谢你。你还好吗？不管怎么说还是谢谢你带来这些东西。

entries.text: My research would have been delayed without them. It's good to see we have such a trustworthy Initiate.# I knew getting an outsider wouldn't be a bad decision. If you go see Michael he will have something for you.
entries.source_text:
My research would have been delayed without them. It's good to see we have such a trustworthy Initiate.
# I knew getting an outsider wouldn't be a bad decision. If you go see Michael he will have something for you.

entries.text: 没有这些东西我的研究就不得不停止了。我很高兴我们有一个像你这样值得信任的新兵，我早就知道让一个外来者加入不可能有错的。如果你去见迈克尔他会给你些东西的。
entries.source_text: 没有这些东西我的研究就不得不停止了。我很高兴我们有一个像你这样值得信任的新兵，我早就知道让一个外来者加入不可能有错的。如果你去见迈克尔他会给你些东西的。

entries.text: Greetings.  I have not seen you here before, are you lost?# May I be of service?
entries.source_text:
Greetings.  I have not seen you here before, are you lost?
# May I be of service?

entries.text: 你好。我从前没有在这边见过你，你迷路了吗？我能帮忙吗？
entries.source_text: 你好。我从前没有在这边见过你，你迷路了吗？我能帮忙吗？

entries.text: Could you direct me to the library?
entries.source_text: Could you direct me to the library?

entries.text: 你能告诉我图书馆怎么走吗？
entries.source_text: 你能告诉我图书馆怎么走吗？

entries.text: I am looking for Vree.
entries.source_text: I am looking for Vree.

entries.text: 我在找弗蕾。
entries.source_text: 我在找弗蕾。

entries.text: What is this place?
entries.source_text: What is this place?

entries.text: 这里是哪里？
entries.source_text: 这里是哪里？

entries.text: If I was lost I wouldn't be asking an idiot like you for help!
entries.source_text: If I was lost I wouldn't be asking an idiot like you for help!

entries.text: 就算我迷路了，我也不会找你这样的白痴问路！
entries.source_text: 就算我迷路了，我也不会找你这样的白痴问路！

entries.text: I can't believe the kind of people we accept as initiates these# days.  God help us.
entries.source_text:
I can't believe the kind of people we accept as initiates these
# days.  God help us.

entries.text: 我简直不敢相信，现在我们会接受这样的人来做新兵。上天保佑。
entries.source_text: 我简直不敢相信，现在我们会接受这样的人来做新兵。上天保佑。

entries.text: This is the library.  Here we keep records of all technical data on# weaponry and technology, and, of course, the history of the Brotherhood.
entries.source_text:
This is the library.  Here we keep records of all technical data on
# weaponry and technology, and, of course, the history of the Brotherhood.

entries.text: 这里是图书馆。我们在这里存储所有关于武器和科技的资料，当然，我们也有关于兄弟会的历史。
entries.source_text: 这里是图书馆。我们在这里存储所有关于武器和科技的资料，当然，我们也有关于兄弟会的历史。

entries.text: I need a water-chip repaired.  Can you help me?
entries.source_text: I need a water-chip repaired.  Can you help me?

entries.text: 我必须要修理好一个净水芯片。你能帮我吗？
entries.source_text: 我必须要修理好一个净水芯片。你能帮我吗？

entries.text: I'd like to know more about the weapons you make here.
entries.source_text: I'd like to know more about the weapons you make here.

entries.text: 关于你们在制造的武器我想知道更多。
entries.source_text: 关于你们在制造的武器我想知道更多。

entries.text: Is this the place where I would find holo-disks?
entries.source_text: Is this the place where I would find holo-disks?

entries.text: 这里是我能找到磁盘的地方吗？
entries.source_text: 这里是我能找到磁盘的地方吗？

entries.text: Nevermind, thank you for your time.
entries.source_text: Nevermind, thank you for your time.

entries.text: 不用了，谢谢你的帮忙。
entries.source_text: 不用了，谢谢你的帮忙。

entries.text: I'm looking for a big gun to improve my people-killing skills.
entries.source_text: I'm looking for a big gun to improve my people-killing skills.

entries.text: 我在找一支可以提高我杀人技术的大枪。
entries.source_text: 我在找一支可以提高我杀人技术的大枪。

entries.text: I am Vree's assistant.  Vree is over there.
entries.source_text: I am Vree's assistant.  Vree is over there.

entries.text: 我是弗蕾的助手。弗蕾在那边。
entries.source_text: 我是弗蕾的助手。弗蕾在那边。

entries.text: Thank you.
entries.source_text: Thank you.

entries.text: 谢谢你。
entries.source_text: 谢谢你。

entries.text: What is it you do as Vree's assistant?
entries.source_text: What is it you do as Vree's assistant?

entries.text: 你作为弗蕾的助手都做些什么呢？
entries.source_text: 你作为弗蕾的助手都做些什么呢？

entries.text: My area of expertise is the history of the Brotherhood.  It sounds# like a manufacturing problem, perhaps you should ask Vree?
entries.source_text:
My area of expertise is the history of the Brotherhood.  It sounds
# like a manufacturing problem, perhaps you should ask Vree?

entries.text: 我的专业涉及的是兄弟会历史方面。你的问题似乎是一个制造方面的问题，也许你该去问弗蕾。
entries.source_text: 我的专业涉及的是兄弟会历史方面。你的问题似乎是一个制造方面的问题，也许你该去问弗蕾。

entries.text: I thought the scribes knew this kind of stuff.
entries.source_text: I thought the scribes knew this kind of stuff.

entries.text: 我以为你们研究员都知道这方面的事情。
entries.source_text: 我以为你们研究员都知道这方面的事情。

entries.text: I'd like to know about the Brotherhood's history.
entries.source_text: I'd like to know about the Brotherhood's history.

entries.text: 我想了解兄弟会的历史。
entries.source_text: 我想了解兄弟会的历史。

entries.text: Lotta help you are!
entries.source_text: Lotta help you are!

entries.text: 你的帮助实在太大啦！
entries.source_text: 你的帮助实在太大啦！

entries.text: OK, thanks for your help.
entries.source_text: OK, thanks for your help.

entries.text: 好的，谢谢你。
entries.source_text: 好的，谢谢你。

entries.text: You must speak with Vree, the head scribe, about that.  I have more# important things to do.
entries.source_text:
You must speak with Vree, the head scribe, about that.  I have more
# important things to do.

entries.text: 关于那件事你必须和研究员负责人弗蕾谈。我有更重要的事情要做。
entries.source_text: 关于那件事你必须和研究员负责人弗蕾谈。我有更重要的事情要做。

entries.text: I will go ask Vree.
entries.source_text: I will go ask Vree.

entries.text: 我会去问弗蕾的。
entries.source_text: 我会去问弗蕾的。

entries.text: More important things to do?  Like what?
entries.source_text: More important things to do?  Like what?

entries.text: 更重要的事情？比如说呢？
entries.source_text: 更重要的事情？比如说呢？

entries.text: You don't consider the Brotherhood's weaponry to be important?
entries.source_text: You don't consider the Brotherhood's weaponry to be important?

entries.text: 你认为兄弟会的武器制造不重要吗？
entries.source_text: 你认为兄弟会的武器制造不重要吗？

entries.text: We have many holo-disks here in the library.  They are divided# between history, technology and weapon design.
entries.source_text:
We have many holo-disks here in the library.  They are divided
# between history, technology and weapon design.

entries.text: 图书馆里有许多磁盘。它们分为历史，科技和武器设计三类。
entries.source_text: 图书馆里有许多磁盘。它们分为历史，科技和武器设计三类。

entries.text: I would like to see a holo-disk on your technology.
entries.source_text: I would like to see a holo-disk on your technology.

entries.text: 我想看看科技方面的磁盘。
entries.source_text: 我想看看科技方面的磁盘。

entries.text: I would like to see a holo-disk on weapon design.
entries.source_text: I would like to see a holo-disk on weapon design.

entries.text: 我想看看武器设计方面的磁盘。
entries.source_text: 我想看看武器设计方面的磁盘。

entries.text: I would like to see a holo-disk on the Brotherhood's history.
entries.source_text: I would like to see a holo-disk on the Brotherhood's history.

entries.text: 我想看看兄弟会历史方面的磁盘。
entries.source_text: 我想看看兄弟会历史方面的磁盘。

entries.text: I was sent here to ask Vree about the history of the Brotherhood.
entries.source_text: I was sent here to ask Vree about the history of the Brotherhood.

entries.text: 我被派到这里问弗蕾关于兄弟会历史的问题。
entries.source_text: 我被派到这里问弗蕾关于兄弟会历史的问题。

entries.text: My area of specialty is the Brotherhood's history.  It seems that# some people around here have forgotten the importance of our history.
entries.source_text:
My area of specialty is the Brotherhood's history.  It seems that
# some people around here have forgotten the importance of our history.

entries.text: 我的专业领域是兄弟会历史方面。好像有些人已经开始忘记我们历史的重要性了。
entries.source_text: 我的专业领域是兄弟会历史方面。好像有些人已经开始忘记我们历史的重要性了。

entries.text: What can you tell me about the Brotherhood's history?
entries.source_text: What can you tell me about the Brotherhood's history?

entries.text: 关于兄弟会的历史你能告诉我什么？
entries.source_text: 关于兄弟会的历史你能告诉我什么？

entries.text: What could be more important than history?
entries.source_text: What could be more important than history?

entries.text: 有什么会比历史更重要呢？
entries.source_text: 有什么会比历史更重要呢？

entries.text: Must be near your time of the month, huh?
entries.source_text: Must be near your time of the month, huh?

entries.text: 你每个月的那几天快来了吧？
entries.source_text: 你每个月的那几天快来了吧？

entries.text: I'd like to ask somebody about weapons.
entries.source_text: I'd like to ask somebody about weapons.

entries.text: 我想问问别人关于武器的事。
entries.source_text: 我想问问别人关于武器的事。

entries.text: Like keeping the history of the Brotherhood.  It seems some people# around here have forgotten just how important our history is.
entries.source_text:
Like keeping the history of the Brotherhood.  It seems some people
# around here have forgotten just how important our history is.

entries.text: 像是保管兄弟会历史等等。看上去有些人已经开始忘记我们历史的重要性了。
entries.source_text: 像是保管兄弟会历史等等。看上去有些人已经开始忘记我们历史的重要性了。

entries.text: Vree seems to think that the research of new weaponry and the# information gathered from Mutant autopsies is more important than our# history.  She has forgotten that our history is a vital part of our lives.# It has gotten so bad that many of the new initiates don't even know who# Roger Maxson is or what exactly he did for us.
entries.source_text:
Vree seems to think that the research of new weaponry and the
# information gathered from Mutant autopsies is more important than our
# history.  She has forgotten that our history is a vital part of our lives.
# It has gotten so bad that many of the new initiates don't even know who
# Roger Maxson is or what exactly he did for us.

entries.text: 弗蕾似乎认为，研究开发新的武器以及解剖变种人尸体比历史更为重要。她忘记了，我们的历史是我们生命的重要组成部分，现在的情况已经很坏了，有很多新兵甚至不知道罗杰·马克松是谁，以及他究竟为我们做过什么。
entries.source_text: 弗蕾似乎认为，研究开发新的武器以及解剖变种人尸体比历史更为重要。她忘记了，我们的历史是我们生命的重要组成部分，现在的情况已经很坏了，有很多新兵甚至不知道罗杰·马克松是谁，以及他究竟为我们做过什么。

entries.text: I'd like to learn more about the Brotherhood's history.  Do you have# any information you can give me?
entries.source_text:
I'd like to learn more about the Brotherhood's history.  Do you have
# any information you can give me?

entries.text: 我想要学习关于兄弟会历史的更多知识。你有什么资料可以给我吗？
entries.source_text: 我想要学习关于兄弟会历史的更多知识。你有什么资料可以给我吗？

entries.text: Hmmm, it looks like Vree is the person I want to talk to. Good Bye.
entries.source_text: Hmmm, it looks like Vree is the person I want to talk to. Good Bye.

entries.text: 嗯，也许弗蕾才是我真正想见的人。再见。
entries.source_text: 嗯，也许弗蕾才是我真正想见的人。再见。

entries.text: It sounds like Vree's got the right idea!  Who needs to know this# garbage anyway!?!
entries.source_text:
It sounds like Vree's got the right idea!  Who needs to know this
# garbage anyway!?!

entries.text: 听起来弗蕾是对的！谁想要了解这些垃圾呢？！
entries.source_text: 听起来弗蕾是对的！谁想要了解这些垃圾呢？！

entries.text: I agree that history is important, but new technology and better# weapons is what I'm looking for.
entries.source_text:
I agree that history is important, but new technology and better
# weapons is what I'm looking for.

entries.text: 我也认为历史是十分重要的，但我现在要找的是新的科技和更好的武器。
entries.source_text: 我也认为历史是十分重要的，但我现在要找的是新的科技和更好的武器。

entries.text: You need to speak with Vree about things of that nature.
entries.source_text: You need to speak with Vree about things of that nature.

entries.text: 这种事情你得去和弗蕾谈。
entries.source_text: 这种事情你得去和弗蕾谈。

entries.text: These are things that only Scribes and Paladins have access to.# Vree may be able to help you.
entries.source_text:
These are things that only Scribes and Paladins have access to.
# Vree may be able to help you.

entries.text: 这些事只有导师和游侠才有资格决定。弗蕾也许可以帮你。
entries.source_text: 这些事只有导师和游侠才有资格决定。弗蕾也许可以帮你。

entries.text: Thank you, I'll go ask Vree.
entries.source_text: Thank you, I'll go ask Vree.

entries.text: 谢谢你，我会去问弗蕾的。
entries.source_text: 谢谢你，我会去问弗蕾的。

entries.text: Is there any holo-disks that I can have access to?
entries.source_text: Is there any holo-disks that I can have access to?

entries.text: 这边有我能拿到的磁盘吗？
entries.source_text: 这边有我能拿到的磁盘吗？

entries.text: You're obviously not the right person to be talking to. Good Bye.
entries.source_text: You're obviously not the right person to be talking to. Good Bye.

entries.text: 很显然，你并不是正确的谈话对象。再见。
